'''Utnesi Wesk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Wielding two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Republic forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
Master Utnesi Wesk was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', which added Conquest Commanders to most of the dual-faction worlds. Wesk is a rare NPC enemy, and his place at [[Outpost Thorazan]] on Tatooine is frequently occupied by a generic Veteran Jedi Battlemaster.
